events.verdict: Brooks (HOU) is in a legal guarding position defending Clarke (MEM) as he elevates for the shot attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) reaches in and deflects the ball away from Sengun (HOU).
Green (HOU) legally contests Wells' (MEM) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.

Clarke (MEM) backs into Sengun (HOU), who is in a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact. Clarke then begins to lose his balance on his own accord and any further contact from Sengun is marginal.
Thompson (HOU) legally contests Clarke's (MEM) shot attempt and Clarke creates the contact by jumping backwards into him.
Clarke (MEM) jumps and maintains a legal vertical position while contesting Green's (HOU) driving shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Morant (MEM) loses control of the ball and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Brooks (HOU) leans into Wells (MEM) and delivers contact, dislodging him from his defensive position.
Clarke (MEM) reaches in and makes contact to Thompson's (HOU) arm, which affects the play near the basket.
Thompson (HOU) extends both hands into Morant's (MEM) body, which affects his SQBR during the drive.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) commits a take foul on VanVleet (HOU).
Green (HOU) legally contests Bane's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
